Entry 1: Enemy Factions Part 1: Isorropians
These are aliens are from the other side of the universe. 
The exonym we have for them comes from the Greek word, "isorropía", the Greek word for "balance" or "equilibrium."
They do not age, but they're not immortal.
They have been fighting with the demons for billions of years.
They're able to take on almost any form they want, they just have to have the energy to do so and they are limited on where they are at.
Their technology far surpasses us, but they have not made any spacecraft capable of faster than light travel. 
They have to spend millions of years traveling to different parts of the solar system, and set up portals to quickly travel from place to place.
They trancend us, but they don't trancend us as much as Yahweh our Lord our God, the only God does.
The isorropians want to destory all life and divinity in the universe.
Their souls aren't like ours, they are physical and are like small stars. When they die, their "souls" explode in a small nuclear explosion.
Their whole bodies are powered by their "souls", almost like they're partially organic robots.
All they have is contempt and malice for anything that lives.
They feel betrayed by God for the demons he "created" and how they devasted the Isorropian race.
We still barely know anything about them, but just like demons, they love to pretend they are deities to fool us.
